notes.title: Sale! (22/4 - 26/4)
notes.content:
Well hello there, you lovely person!

For this week (22/4 - 26/4) Aperion Cyberstorm is on sale for 66% off!

Jump into all three modes solo or with your friends locally for a (bullet-)hellishly good time.

If you like what you've played, please consider leaving a review. It helps us massively. :)

See you out there, pilots!

notes.title: The reviews are in!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28040815/5ad9df978774d0c95f2f7a79b763094da0282c62.jpg[/img]

[h1]Aperion Cyberstorm is now out![/h1]
 
If you haven't taken the plunge yet, let the critics speak for themselves:

[b]Nintendolife - 8/10[/b]
"Aperion Cyberstorm is another confident slice of shooter fun from Britain’s burgeoning indie dev scene."

[b]Vooks - 4.5/5[/b]
"Overall, Aperion Cyberstorm is a well polished and incredibly fun game."
 
[b]Switch Score - 95/100[/b]
"If complete nonsense, chaos and lots of explosions with friends is what you’re looking for, this is the game for you."

[b]Nintendo Village - 4/5[/b]
"Aperion Cyberstorm is a prime example of how multiplayer can be featured throughout an entire game and is easily its greatest asset, with single JoyCon play also an added bonus."

[b]Nintendo Play - 4.5/5 Highly Recommended[/b]
"So go out, make some friends, and then invite them round for a gaming session to soak up the full experience of everything Aperion Cyberstorm has to offer."
 
[b]NintendoTown - 8.5/10[/b]
"Définitivement, Aperion Cyberstorm est un titre à posséder dans sa ludothèque Nintendo Switch."

So there you have it. If you haven't grabbed the game, now's a great time to jump in, and if you've already got Aperion Cyberstorm we'd love to hear your thoughts on social media or in the forums!

Have fun everyone - byeee!

notes.title: Aperion Cyberstorm coming to Switch - Releases *early* 2018
notes.content:
Good news!

If you like to game on the go, then you'll be happy to know Aperion Cyberstorm is coming to Switch!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28040815/54fba7be5a318aa4b51b310a662cf5f4286dc39d.png[/img]

We’ve added a ton of features to the game since our last major announcement, including AI players for constant five player battles in versus, unlockable maps as a reward for making it through each of the game’s three modes, unlockable difficulty and Boss Rush modes, and additional customisation options to suit as many players as possible.

The game also records the types of kills you get in each mode once you make a player profile, for those who like to know the nitty-gritty of how many thousands of enemy they exploded.

We also looked at some of the features needed or asked for by gamers of all abilities, so Aperion Cyberstorm also comes with:
•	Reversed controls (lefty-flip),
•	Auto-fire,
•	Independent automatic Ability activation, and
•	Text resizing for UI and campaign dialogue

Apologies for the delay, but we wanted to get all our ducks in a row. :)

Aperion Cyberstorm will release for Steam and Switch *early* 2018!
